title: Host Lifecycle Evidence Lockdown
canonical_rule: Librarium remains canonical. MBBSEmu is external evidence only; it informs host timing but does not become game truth.
confirmed_evidence_level: Derived/Observed from MBBSEmu implementation evidence; Classic MajorBBS parity still requires historical/runtime corroboration.
host_lifecycle_order: WaitForNextTick gate (configurable Timer.Hertz when idle; immediate when input/output/status work exists)

timing_findings.modem_latency_effect: Affects visible delivery/latency but not shown as gameplay clock source in MBBSEmu evidence.
timing_findings.one_second_clock: GALGSBL TICKER increments once per second.
timing_findings.idle_loop_gate: Timer.Hertz controls idle WorkerThread wakeups when no pending session work exists.
timing_findings.busy_loop: Pending client input, outgoing data, or DataToProcess bypasses the wait and causes immediate processing.
timing_findings.fast_real_time: RTIHDLR approximately 18Hz if module registers it.
timing_findings.polling: BEGIN_POLLING is per-channel and called as often as possible while registered.

promotion_decision.reason: MBBSEmu confirms its host lifecycle implementation and strongly supports host-driven timing, but exact Classic MajorBBS/Worldgroup timing parity still needs corroborating historical/runtime evidence.
